label: Possibly a CONCRETE_AND_ABSTRACT_6 necessary being, from earlier grounds
description: Discloses what the A3 prime support bundle already carries. In the witnessing history, a contingent concrete thing present at t has a concrete ground present strictly earlier, at s. If that ground is contingent, repeat at s. The founded past of t (Acc induction) ends the descent at a ground that is concrete, exists in that history and is not contingent, hence exists in every world accessible from that history (classical case split). So possibly a necessary concrete individual exists; under actual reflexivity and a Euclidean frame that is a necessary concrete individual at the selected world. A rival who denies that a necessary concrete being is possible must therefore reject the possible earlier-grounded history (or founded populated pasts) outright, whatever it says about H1. Both premises are OPEN. No premise is established.
